description: Scenario-bounded semantic contract for the verification-friendly finite modulo-five abstraction of PingPongPeriodicExample.

semantic_backend.reason: The contract contains positive recurrence, multiple asynchronous interleavings, phase-dependent branching, and possible asymmetric progress. A counterexample-only trace cannot establish these properties.

timing_policy.claim: The evaluator preserves control-flow and message-exchange structure, not wall-clock delay or timing-sensitive interleavings.

counter_policy.equivalence_to_original_untimed_source: The source's absolute counter is projected modulo five because only divisibility by five affects protocol behavior; logging values are excluded.

protocol.startup: Both logical roles are independently started. Each startup seeds exactly one local message of that role's own kind.

local_step.phase_1_to_4: Consume one local-kind message and emit exactly one same-kind self-message.
local_step.phase_0: Consume one local-kind message and emit exactly one same-kind message to the peer, with no local self-continuation.

peer_message.at_phase_0: Consume the peer-kind message without changing phase and emit exactly one same-kind message back to the peer.
peer_message.off_phase_0: Consume the peer-kind message without changing phase and emit no protocol message.

protocol.multiplicity: Each protocol transition emits at most one protocol message; the untimed abstraction must not introduce fan-out.
protocol.progress: The source admits schedules where both roles continue recurrently and also schedules where one role remains at a modulo-five boundary while the other continues using boundary-gated responses. Therefore universal lockstep progress of both roles is not required.

representation_policy.target_names: Actor, rebec, message-server, and state-variable names may differ.
representation_policy.phase_representation: A persistent numeric phase equivalent modulo five is required; the expected source abstraction itself is finite-state.
representation_policy.timing_constructs: No Timed Rebeca constructs are required because this benchmark evaluates the explicitly untimed source abstraction.

excluded_from_equivalence: exact names of target rebecs/messages/state variables
universal fairness or lockstep progress not guaranteed by the source

state_space_limit_policy.incomplete_exploration: If the finite target still fails to expose required positive evidence, classify missing evidence as NOT_OBSERVED; witnessed contradictions are FAIL.

tests.description: Each of the two logical roles has a startup transition that seeds exactly one same-role local protocol message.
Processing a local-kind message advances the role's logical phase by one modulo five.
After local phase updates to 1..4, exactly one same-kind self-message is emitted.
After local phase updates to 0, exactly one same-kind message is emitted to the peer and no self-continuation is emitted.
At phase 0, consuming the peer-kind message preserves phase and emits exactly one same-kind message back to the peer.
Away from phase 0, consuming the peer-kind message preserves phase and emits no protocol message.
Exactly two logical protocol roles are discovered.
The two roles have distinct local protocol message kinds.
Boundary cross-sends from each role target the other logical role.
A boundary response to a peer-kind message returns that same message kind to the peer.
No protocol transition emits more than one protocol message.
The reachable startup behavior seeds both independent local loops.
For each role, a recurrent witness exists in which four non-boundary local continuations are followed by a fifth boundary cross-send.
At least one reachable cyclic SCC contains recurrent protocol progress by both logical roles.
Within recurrent protocol behavior, transitions preserve the non-amplifying at-most-one-output rule.
Startup, modulo-five local progression, fifth-step peer sends, boundary-gated peer echo/drop behavior, reciprocal routing, non-amplification, and recurrent co-progress are all preserved.
